```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r df creation}
# create inc_sessions if not already

inc_sessions <- inc_sneek %>%
  group_by(subject, session) %>%
  summarise(
    drug = first(drug),  # or use unique(drug)[1] if unsure
    sex = first(sex),
    across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
library(janitor)

# Tabulate sex by drug and session
inc_sessions %>%
  tabyl(drug, session, sex)
```

```{r}
library(gt)
library(dplyr)

demographics_table <- inc_sessions %>%
  count(drug, session, sex) %>%
  arrange(drug, session, sex)

print(demographics_table)

demographics_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Demographic Breakdown by Drug, Session, and Sex"
  )
```


```{r}
inc_sessions %>%
  distinct(subject, sex) %>%  # collapse to unique subjects
  count(sex)
```
